# Seeking Lost

> > Thru-hiking and backpacking adventures across America's long-distance trails and wilderness areas

Seeking Lost documents multi-day backpacking trips and thru-hikes including the Mojave-Sonoran Trail, Continental Divide Trail, Oregon Desert Trail, and Basin And Range Trail. The site features detailed trip reports, trail journals, and hiking photography from national parks and wilderness areas across the United States.

## Key Topics

- Mojave-Sonoran Trail
- Continental Divide Trail
- Oregon Desert Trail
- Basin And Range Trail
- Big Bend National Park
- Dolly Sods Wilderness
- Porcupine Mountains
- Thru-hiking
- Backpacking trip reports
- Trail journals
- Winter camping
- Florida springs
- National park backpacking
- Hiking photography
- Long-distance hiking
